acceptance.title: extractNetErrorCode 逐层下钻 err.cause 提取网络错误码
acceptance.command: env ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 pnpm install --silent && cd apps/electron && npx vitest run main/update/__tests__/update.test.ts -t 'W1-extractNetErrorCode'
acceptance.scenario: 从 ../net-errors 导入 extractNetErrorCode：(1) cause.code=ECONNREFUSED → 'ECONNREFUSED'；(2) cause.code=ENOTFOUND → 'ENOTFOUND'；(3) cause.code=ECONNRESET → 'ECONNRESET'；(4) cause.code=ETIMEDOUT → 'ETIMEDOUT'；(5) cause.code=ECONNABORTED → 'ECONNABORTED'；(6) cause.code=EHOSTUNREACH → 'EHOSTUNREACH'；(7) cause.message 含 'ECONNREFUSED'（无 code 字段）→ 'ECONNREFUSED'；(8) err.message='fetch failed' 无 cause → undefined。

acceptance.title: classifyProxyUnreachable macOS+EHOSTUNREACH+私网三条件组合
acceptance.command: env ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 pnpm install --silent && cd apps/electron && npx vitest run main/update/__tests__/update.test.ts -t 'W1-classifyProxyUnreachable'
acceptance.scenario: 从 ../net-errors 导入 classifyProxyUnreachable：(1) darwin + cause.code=EHOSTUNREACH + proxyUrl='http://192.168.1.202:7890' → true；(2) darwin + cause.code=EHOSTUNREACH + proxyUrl='http://203.0.113.1:7890'（公网）→ false；(3) darwin + cause.code=ECONNREFUSED + proxyUrl='http://192.168.1.202:7890' → false；(4) win32 + cause.code=EHOSTUNREACH + proxyUrl='http://192.168.1.202:7890' → false。

acceptance.title: UpdateError 类结构验证
acceptance.command: env ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 pnpm install --silent && cd apps/electron && npx vitest run main/update/__tests__/update.test.ts -t 'W1-UpdateError-class'
acceptance.scenario: 验证 UpdateError 类的基本结构：(1) 继承 Error；(2) 有 stage 属性；(3) 有 errorCode 属性；(4) 有 toUserFriendly 方法返回 UpdateErrorInfo。

contracts.signature: export interface UpdateErrorPayload { stage: UpdateStage; message: string; errorCode?: string; suggestion?: string }
contracts.description: UpdateErrorPayload 类型导出——preload.ts / lib/ipc.ts 两层类型签名的共同依赖。

contracts.signature: export function extractNetErrorCode(err: unknown): string | undefined
contracts.description: 逐层下钻 err.cause?.code ?? err.cause?.message 提取网络错误码。参数 err 为 unknown 类型（兼容任意 thrown 值）。

contracts.signature: export function classifyProxyUnreachable(err: unknown, proxyUrl: string | undefined): boolean
contracts.description: 代理不可达分类：process.platform === 'darwin' && extractNetErrorCode(err) === 'EHOSTUNREACH' && isPrivateHost(proxyUrl) → true；不满足任一条件 → false。

contracts.signature: export interface UpdateErrorPayload { stage: UpdateStage; message: string; errorCode?: string; suggestion?: string }
contracts.description: 同 C1，确保 shared 类型在 w2/w3 消费侧可用。
